english.meaning: to a bad degree; too much or too few
english.note: 熱得滯又辛苦 means too hot and tiring.

exampleSentences.english: Everything’s so boring. I said I wanted a holiday, but now I don’t know what to do. When I was in school, I had too much to do.
exampleSentences.traditional: 做乜嘢都悶𡃉喇，唉，都話放假，一放假又唔知做乜嘢喎。返學嗰時呢𠻺多嘢做得滯喎。
